description: P3 consumer-assertion: CHECK 12 (No bare validation-tool/manifest token in governance/agents prose) in tools/policy_check.sh is load-bearing genericness doctrine. This fixture pins its CHECK12_DENYLIST token literals so deleting a guarded validation-tool/manifest token silently weakens the guard. extract_regex captures each pipe-delimited alternation token from the denylist string; superset mode fails if any required token is removed (extras from other DENYLIST assignments are ignored).
